visuals.header: // Aurora: Undulating volumetric light curtains.
// Bloom: Aurora ink clouds with bass light-leak portals and electric treble veins over black.

// Braid: Three luminous threads — bass, mid, treble — braid around a shared axis in pseudo-3D: each thread rides its own band trace, beatPhase drives the twist, and crossings spit sparks on the beat.
// Chrome: Raymarched liquid-metal blob, accent reflections.
// Circuit: Beat pulses through a neon circuit board.
// Comets: Orbital comet trails crossing a dark stage.
// Constellation: Audio-reactive node network with travelling links.
// Crystal: Faceted gem refracting; fractures on transients.
// Cymatics/Prism: A prismatic cymatics ring with audio-carved contours.
// Drift: Liquid-glass caustic linework over dark glass; artwork becomes a low-frequency tint.
// Dunes: Topographic neon wire landscape with beat crests.
// Event Horizon: Gravitational vortex: sheared spiral accretion arms, doppler beaming, HDR photon ring, infalling embers, absolute black core.
// Filament: A single elastic string plucked by the music: band-weighted standing-wave harmonics decay between beats, node beads glow with their harmonic, and bass bows the whole span.
// Glyph: Rotating spectral sigil with broken rings and radial bars.
// Helix: Double-helix spectral ribbons with beat sparks.
// Ink: Luminous ink in dark water: onsets drop dye charges colored by timbre, kicks send buoyant plumes mushrooming upward; the feedback buffer is the fluid.

// Interference: Bass, mid and treble each radiate circular wavefronts shaped by their own trace; where crests align the water burns HDR-hot with moiré shimmer, and every beat re-anchors the emitters with a soft shockwave.
// Kaleidoscope: Spectrum folded into a morphing mandala.
// Laser Tunnel: Wireframe laser flythrough: polygonal frames and corner rails with HDR cores, rotating sweep beam, beat shock frames.
// Lattice: Prismatic cymatics ring: rainbow contour wires in perspective with glossy floor reflection.
// Lens: Sound as mass: band-driven bodies lens a nebula (or the artwork) with chromatic dispersion; sustained energy inspirals them into a black hole with a photon ring.
// Liquid Optics: Artwork through rippling glass: fbm water refraction, chromatic split, HDR caustic web, bass ripple bursts.
// Loom: The song, woven: the shuttle lays live spectrum as glowing weft while already-woven history recedes to the horizon; bass ripples travel back through the cloth.
// Lumen Field: Field of spectral light pillars on a mirror floor: HDR tip orbs, rising energy pulses, rippled reflections.
// Memory Tunnel: Photo tiles stretched into a beat-pulsing perspective corridor.
// Mirror Bloom: A living Rorschach: band traces folded around the mirror axis shape an ink-blot that breathes with amplitude, feathers its edges with treble, and throws symmetric splatter on flux.
// Murmuration: Flock of light: three band-driven sub-flocks over a dark reflective floor; bass hits rupture the murmuration like a predator strike.
// Nebula: Volumetric fluid/smoke stirred by bands.
// Oscillo Ring: The waveform bent into a closed ring: a live radial trace breathes on bass, echo rings detach and decay outward on every beat, and treble sparks orbit the rim.
// Particles: GPU swarm bursting on the beat.
// Petals: Spectral flower rosette with beat-blooming edges.
// Phosphor Scope: Vintage CRT oscilloscope in a dark room: bass-vs-mid Lissajous figures morph with timbre, the beam kicks on onsets, and phosphor persistence smears the trace into glowing memory.
// Photo Curtain: Photo converted into vertical spectral light curtains.
// Photo gallery: Floating hologram photo cards drifting in depth.
// Photo Glass: Photo-textured translucent towers on a reflective black floor.
// Photo Lens: Shattered mirrored photo shards inside a chromatic lens.
// Photo Liquid: Photo melts into fluid ink and neon veins.
// Photo Particles: Image dissolves into chromatic spectrum particles.
// Photo Prism: Album/photo texture refracted into a circular waveform lens.
// Photo Topography: Photo-derived heightfield as glowing contour terrain.
// Photo Veil: Photo texture embedded in translucent aurora ribbons.
// Plasma: Domain-warped plasma: bass folds the field, treble frays it into glints.
// Prism Room: Faceted caustic chamber: kaleidoscopic glass panes lit per band, caustic sweeps on the beat, HDR edge filaments and vertex glints.
// Pulse: Black-room solar core: breathing disk, prismatic corona rings, treble sparks.
// Rain: Neon spectrum rain over a glossy black floor.
// Reactor: Fusion core with orbiting spectrum arcs and sparks.
// Ribbons: Layered silk-light ribbons with spectral edge highlights.
// Ripple: Beat-thrown cymatics ripples; newborn rings blaze gold, older rings cool to cyan-violet.
// Seismograph: Four recording pens (bass, mid, treble, flux) draw scrolling traces on ruled paper; onsets jolt the needles, beats leave tick-marks, and heavy flux bleeds the ink.
// Spectral City: A pulse-array skyline over a glossy black floor.
// Spectrum: Neon glass skyline: spectrum columns, spark shafts, circuit floor, molten waveform ribbon.
// Starfield: Warp-speed hyperspace; streaks lock to tempo.

// Strata Ridge: Unknown Pleasures, elevated: a stack of waveform traces recedes upward in perspective, near ridges occluding the old; bass lifts the live peaks, onsets race a shimmer along the front ridge.
// Terrain: Pulse-array city skyline with a floor grid and a hot waveform river.
// Tunnel: Opaque 3D flythrough; speed locks to BPM.
// Vault: The song as architecture: a slow glide through raymarched halls whose rooms follow the track's sections — ribs pulse on the beat, treble lights the clerestory.
// Vinyl: Luminous record grooves with beat needle sparks.
// Volumetric Light: Projector haze: band-driven beam fan with HDR spines, drifting dust motes, light leaks along the frame.
// Wave Cascade: A live trace rides the top of the frame; each beat shears off a sheet of it that falls, fades, and stacks into a luminous waterfall while onsets fling spray off the crest.

// Wave Tunnel: Fly down a tunnel extruded from the trace history: every depth ring is a past waveform slice, beats lurch the camera forward, onsets flash the nearest ring, timbre tilts the flight path.
// Waveform: Prismatic oscilloscope threads: stacked spectral wave wires with transient pins on black.
